name: Mifune Ashura
source:
He is a skilled swordsman who continues his journey of training. He is silent, arrogant, ruthless, and a demon of the art of war.
He believes that the only thing he can rely on in the world is his own skill.
He is a man who has no sense of right or wrong, and is obsessed with nothing but his own self-possession.
He has lost his left eye and wears an eye patch. Therefore, attacks from his right eye appear to be effective, but on the contrary, he claims to have "gained a mind's eye in his left eye" (according to him) in place of his lost sight, and is able to recognize everything even in the dark.

The werewolf fiasco has led him to become a prey of the "Jinbu-gumi," a Japanese yakuza clan that is one of the three main gangs in the Amidahara area.
He is a perfect human being and possesses terrifying power, even though he has not acquired any deformed or magical powers. He is a superhuman being.
He is said to have traveled alone to the demon world and other dimensions inhabited by demons, and there are rumors that he is over 300 years old.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=680360]Getchu[/url]]
